description: Exports the page's window.DUR and window.EV (sound and cue events) to JSON for the mix. Returns the path and the number of events.

demo.description: Folder that holds the film's index.html (absolute path, or relative to the library root).

q.description: Query string passed to the page as location.search, e.g. 'lang=en&cut=b'.

size.description: Frame size WxH, even numbers. Default 1920x1080; 1080x1920 for a vertical Short.
